# Work Card: Add Risk Router

## Work Card ID

WC04

Created: 2026-06-29T00:00:00.000Z
Updated: 2026-06-29T00:00:00.000Z

## Phase

phase-01

## Status

ready_for_builder

## What Problem Are We Solving?

ChampCity A/I needs a deterministic MVP Risk Router that evaluates saved Work Card JSON files, highlights risk categories, and saves durable risk review artifacts without using an LLM.

## What Should This Accomplish?

Add a Risk Router screen and shared deterministic routing logic that classifies Work Card risk as low, medium, or high, shows flagged categories and Architect review questions, and saves Markdown risk reviews.

## What Should the User Be Able To Do?

The Operator can select a saved Work Card JSON file, see deterministic risk guidance, and save a Risk Review artifact for Architect review without modifying the selected Work Card.

## What Is Included?

- Add minimal navigation for `Risk Router` alongside `New Work Card` and `Architect Prompt Composer`.
- Reuse constrained Work Card listing and read patterns for saved JSON files under `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Work_Cards/`.
- Validate loaded Work Card JSON with the existing Work Card validator before routing risk.
- Create shared deterministic risk router logic under `src/shared/workCards/`.
- Flag high-risk categories using transparent keyword and phrase matching across Work Card text fields.
- Detect simple scope-creep signals when multiple large work types are mentioned together.
- Generate practical Architect review questions for high-risk categories and scope-creep signals.
- Build a simple Risk Router screen that shows selected Work Card metadata, current risk level, assessed risk level, flagged categories, matched terms, scope-creep signals, and Architect review questions.
- Add constrained IPC support to save Risk Review Markdown under `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Risk_Reviews/`.
- Add a Risk Review Markdown renderer with a clear note that the review does not modify or approve the Work Card.
- Create the WC04 Work Card artifact and Builder Report.
- Extend lightweight Work Card validation coverage for risk routing, risk review rendering, and path safety.

## What Is Not Included?

- Do not call an LLM API.
- Do not implement automatic Architect reasoning.
- Do not generate the final Builder prompt.
- Do not modify selected Work Card JSON or Markdown.
- Do not change Work Card status.
- Do not update Work Card `riskLevel`.
- Do not mark anything as `ready_for_builder` from the UI.
- Do not auto-approve low-risk work.
- Do not implement Work Card editing.
- Do not implement Builder Report capture workflow.
- Do not implement validation/repair loop.
- Do not add provider SDKs, external API integrations, database, cloud, authentication, deployment, MCP, or connector integrations.
- Do not perform a broad UI redesign.

## Requirements

- Default the Risk Router phase to `phase-01`.
- Renderer code must not read or write files directly.
- Filesystem reads and writes must be mediated by constrained main/preload IPC.
- IPC must normalize and validate paths, reject traversal, reject arbitrary absolute paths, restrict phase names to safe values, and read only `.json` Work Card files.
- Risk routing must be deterministic and must not call an LLM, external APIs, or filesystem APIs.
- Use only the existing `low`, `medium`, and `high` risk-level values.
- Classify high risk when Work Card text indicates secrets, auth, unsafe filesystem writes, databases or migrations, cloud or deployment, payment or account deletion, external providers, MCP or connectors, security policy, destructive Git/GitHub actions, large dependency upgrades, or broad refactors.
- Classify medium risk for normal implementation, UI, validation, or limited planning-file work when no high-risk category is found.
- Classify low risk only for clearly documentation-only, prompt/report, or similarly low-impact work.
- Low risk must not imply approval and normal Architect review must still be required.
- Save risk review artifacts with filenames matching `RISK_REVIEW_<work_card_id>_<slug>.md`.
- WC04 must not modify Work Cards, Work Card status, or Work Card `riskLevel`.

## How We Know This Is Done

- Navigation shows `New Work Card`, `Architect Prompt Composer`, and `Risk Router`.
- Risk Router lists saved Work Card JSON files for `phase-01`.
- Selecting a Work Card displays its ID, title, phase, and current Work Card `riskLevel`.
- Risk Router displays assessed risk level as `low`, `medium`, or `high`.
- Risk Router displays flagged categories, matched terms or rationale, scope-creep signals, and Architect review questions.
- High-risk Work Cards show a warning not to send directly to Builder until Architect review.
- Low-risk Work Cards do not show automatic approval language.
- Saving creates Markdown under `planning/phases/phase-01/Risk_Reviews/`.
- Risk Review Markdown includes assessed risk level, flagged categories, scope-creep signals, Architect review questions, generated timestamp, and a note that it does not modify or approve the Work Card.
- Work Card JSON and Markdown files are not modified by the Risk Router.
- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run test:work-cards` pass.

## How This Should Be Validated

- Run `npm run typecheck`.
- Run `npm run build`.
- Run `npm test`.
- Run `npm run test:work-cards`.
- Run `git status --short` and review changed files.
- Manually run `npm start` to validate the Electron UI.

## Risk Level

medium

## Risks and Watch Items

- Keyword routing can produce false positives when risky topics are listed as out of scope.
- Manual Electron UI validation is still required because no renderer smoke test exists yet.
- Path safety must remain constrained as new planning artifact folders are added.
- Risk review wording must not imply automatic approval or Work Card mutation.

## Builder Instructions

- Verify the repository path before editing.
- Read `AGENTS.md`, the WC01-WC03 Builder Reports, and the existing WC01-WC03 Work Card artifacts before implementation.
- Keep the pass limited to WC04 deterministic risk routing, constrained IPC, risk review saving, validation coverage, the WC04 Work Card artifact, and the Builder Report.
- Do not call LLM APIs, generate final Builder prompts, modify selected Work Cards, update Work Card statuses or risk levels, add provider SDKs, or implement unrelated features.
- Run the required validation commands and document results in the Builder Report.
- Stage only files created or modified for WC04 and commit with `feat: add work card risk router`.

## Operator Notes

- A Work Card should never be authored by the Operator alone.
- WC04 produces deterministic risk review guidance only.
- The Risk Router does not mark Work Cards as Builder-ready.
- Low risk means no major risk flags were detected; it does not mean the Work Card is approved.
- The recommended next Builder task is Work Card 5: Generate Builder prompt.
